verdicts.reason: Both scramble the message into 'PRAY / When Life Is Great / When Life Is Rough / PRAY', which wrecks the original's paired couplet structure. Both also move the divider below the rose, where it floats meaninglessly in dead space, and both show the rose's rectangular crop edges as hard cuts. A is jammed against the top edge with cramped, left-ragged lines. B has a better top margin, but its last 'PRAY' is noticeably smaller than the first, which adds inconsistency, and its smaller rose leaves even more empty space. A is marginally less bad.
